matching_analysis.decision_from_frozen_audit: Retain as partial progress plus scope narrowing, not a direct resolution or contradiction. A decisive test needs project-disjoint DNN repair units, a code-only baseline, verified fix success, regression/security checks and independent seeds/models.

model_and_assumptions.frozen_comparison: DNN-aware versus code-only repair/localization on project-disjoint held-out bug/repair units; verified fix rate, regression rate and security-relevant regression rate
